motions.limit_text: All 24 asymmetric launch variants failed to complete a side flip. The selected attempt reaches 169–170° at both tested timesteps and strikes the body. Playback stops at first contact. This is nominal programmed simulation, with rigid tires and ideal gears; physical impact and recovery remain unqualified.

limitations: Finite asymmetric launch screen; not proof of hardware impossibility or optimal control.
Ends at first wheel/body contact or the first invalid native state; no ground rolling or settled landing is counted.
Rigid tires, ideal gears, nominal unweighed/electrical priors and incomplete self-contact. No hardware claim.
